speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have yellowish skin and eyes, and you seem quite agitated. Do you have any abdominal pain or fever? How long have you noticed these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 20-year-old male. The patient was previously healthy and has been brought to the emergency department due to agitation over the past 24 hours. Family members have noticed a yellowish coloring of his skin and eyes over the past week. The patient has a history of occasional cocaine and ecstasy use, and drinks alcohol socially on weekends. The patient also admits to high-risk sexual behaviors without using appropriate protection.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of high-risk sexual behavior, have you experienced any nausea, vomiting, or loss of appetite recently? I need to check if you have any right upper quadrant tenderness or hepatomegaly during this physical exam.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a history of hepatitis B vaccination, or have you noticed your urine turning dark or your stools becoming pale? I need to assess for signs of acute liver failure given your risk factors. REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Panel

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Bilirubin: 25 mg/dL (elevated), AST: 600 IU/L (elevated), ALT: 650 IU/L (elevated), TP Activity: < 40% (reduced), INR: 1.5 (elevated)

speaker: Doctor
text: Your lab results show severe liver dysfunction with high bilirubin and enzymes. To pinpoint the cause, have you recently engaged in unprotected sex with new partners, or do you use intravenous drugs? REQUEST TEST: Hepatitis_Panel

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the hepatitis panel is normal, let's look at other causes. Have you taken any acetaminophen or other medications recently, or are you experiencing any abdominal pain or fever? REQUEST TEST: Acetaminophen_Level

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the severe coagulopathy and agitation, I need to rule out acute liver failure from other toxicities. Have you consumed any wild mushrooms or unknown herbal supplements recently? REQUEST TEST: Serum_Toxology_Screen

speaker: Doctor
text: With common viral, drug, and toxin causes ruled out, I suspect an autoimmune etiology given your demographics. REQUEST TEST: Autoimmune_Heptitis_Panel

speaker: Doctor
text: With viral, toxic, and autoimmune causes excluded, I need to assess for metabolic or vascular issues like Wilson's disease or Budd-Chiari syndrome. Do you have a family history of liver disease, or have you noticed any Kayser-Fleischer rings in your eyes? REQUEST TEST: Ceruloplasmin_Level

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the severe liver failure with negative viral, toxic, and metabolic workups, I suspect an acute vascular occlusion. REQUEST TEST: Abdominal_Doppler_Ultrasound

speaker: Doctor
text:
Given the acute presentation of liver failure with agitation, jaundice, and coagulopathy in a young male with negative workup for viral, toxic, autoimmune, and common metabolic causes, I suspect an acute biliary obstruction or atypical infection not yet covered. REQUEST TEST: MRCP

DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Liver Failure due to undiagnosed etiology (likely acute biliary obstruction or rare infectious cause)
